fields.description: Whether this type is offered when somebody writes a new announcement. Disabling a type retires it from the picker without touching the announcements already filed under it, so a society's own history stays readable.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: What this type is for, in the society's own words. Shown to whoever is writing an announcement so that a vocabulary of five types does not become five people's guesses at what each one means.
fields.label: Description
